title: Paper Towel Holder Stand 14.4-Inch Solid Brass, Freestanding | Shaded Beige | Carolina | Allied Brass
description:
Need a paper towel roll holder that stays put on the counter? This freestanding paper towel holder stand keeps the roll upright for space-saving storage and a steady pull when you tear off sheets in Shaded Beige, which offers sophisticated warmth in a soft, neutral tone that complements natural materials and earthy palettes.

Highlights:
- Shaded Beige transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your kitchen
- Countertop protection built in with a felt pad on the base
- Coordinate a matching Carolina look with the Carolina Collection
- Solid brass construction with a designer finish for corrosion-free and rust-free performance

Specs & Installation:
- Collection: Carolina
- Style: Traditional
- Material: Brass
- Mounting: Freestanding
- Assembly required: No
- Dimensions: 6.5 in L x 6.5 in W x 14.4 in H; projection 6.5 in
- Weight capacity: 5 lb
- Product weight: 4 lb
- Included items: Paper towel holder
- Finish variety: Multiple designer finish options available
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
